records.source_statement: A new subsection asks when marriage will be broken and the cause thereof.
limitations: Text begins low PDF344 and continues onto PDF345.

records.source_statement: A planet receiving significators' light that is itself heavy, squared/opposed by ill planet or cadent is said to frustrate the intended marriage.
limitations: The alleged adverse receiver must mediate signifiers before failing.

records.source_statement: After interrupted engagement, Lilly compares which partner's significator remains strongest to infer who will marry another first.
limitations: Conditional on break-off, not a fresh unrelated natal marriage.

records.source_statement: Ill planet hindering match as ruler of second or eighth indicates dispute over dowry or marriage portion.
limitations: House rulers as alternatives, not both required.

records.source_statement: Frustrating planet as third-house ruler is associated with brother as impediment.
limitations: Not independently identifying a real family member.

records.source_statement: Fourth or tenth lord as hindrance is attributed to father or mother, depending chart roles.
limitations: Historical family-role mapping, not a certain opponent.

records.source_statement: An ill planet transferring light between the significators is construed as a messenger/intermediary causing break-up, whose category comes from its house.
limitations: Planet must actually carry light between relevant bodies.
